title: Explain checkable authoring corrections within owner boundaries
statement: The Authoring guidance Module shall explain a supported authoring or correction outcome from its identified canonical rule and subject basis, preserving method ownership, unresolved decisions, representation limits and separate execution authority.

what.problem: A structural diagnostic or plausible example can be mistaken for a correct authorized engineering edit.
what.desired_outcome: Explain checkable authoring corrections within owner boundaries.

why.rationale: SR-033 needs an accountable MOD-008 obligation at the IF-008 guidance boundary; existing workflow AR-029/033 do not cover this complete guidance responsibility.

stakeholders: New REM authors with basic engineering knowledge

conditions: During the selected authoring/correction or prepared guidance-assessment activity, and when its material source or subject basis changes.

contexts: MOD-008 contribution to MOD-017 IF-008, with MOD-012 guided consumption and existing IF-014 assurance/IF-004 recording when selected.

how.approach: Apply guidance.md to exact declared inputs and owned source meanings; preserve actor decisions, incomplete scope and separately observed effects.

how_much.scope: The complete allocated contribution to SR-033 within the declared finite activity/profile/task scope; no universal usability, runtime automation or population claim.

acceptance_criteria: Explain 5W2H and single-parent requirement derivation, black-box Scenarios, Feature/Function distinctions and consistent AR/Function/Module and Interface responsibility using applicable rules and worked reasoning.
For an identifiable finding, relate the diagnostic, affected subject and rule to a proposed correction and applicable checks; missing or changed basis prevents an unsupported complete-fix claim.

For rename and retirement, explain preserved identity/parentage and reference reconciliation or explicit surviving-obligation disposition and recoverable historical meaning; do not execute the action through guidance.

Return unresolved decisions, unsupported representations and authority limits with the next responsible clarification; do not treat a recommendation, conformant example or completed explanation as approval or satisfaction.
constraints: Guidance and Design coverage do not establish participant success, execution authority or installed support.

sources.basis: Define source-bound guidance selection, bounded authoring/correction and participant-assisted semantic task assessment, with justified MOD-008 allocation and existing assurance/recording cooperation. Target Design only; no observed usability or installed capability claim.
